name: Nalfeshnee

actions.name: Horror Nimbus
actions.effect: Multicolored, eldritch light erupts from the Nalfeshnee. All creatures within 5m must pass WILL save or be frightened and stunned for 1 round. On a success, creatures are only frightened for 1 round. Usable once per encounter.

reactions.name: Teleport
reactions.effect: When hit by an attack, the Nalfeshnee teleports up to 36m to any location it can see. The triggering attack misses.

reactions.name: Magic Resistance
reactions.effect: +2d6 to a save against a spell or magical effect.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: Can fly despite its bulk. Does not provoke reactions when flying out of reach.

traits.name: Abyssal Judge
traits.desc: The Nalfeshnee can sense the deepest sins and regrets of any creature within 18m. It uses this knowledge to demoralize foes.

lore: Nalfeshnees are obese, boar-headed demons that serve as judges of the Abyss. Despite their grotesque appearance, they possess terrifying intelligence and magical power. Their horror nimbus has driven entire armies mad.
